answer: In this design, each agent identity is provisioned only after remote attestation verifies its enclave’s MRENCLAVE and binds the identity key to a hardware-rooted, non-exportable secret. A copied virtual machine can reproduce software but not that secret or valid platform attestation, so creating another accepted identity requires another eligible physical processor rather than merely more virtual machines. Yarrow, timber, and umber are harmless labels, not identity credentials.
